say:0:1010413401:0.text:
Whoa, that gruglin is bigger than the others.
He looks even crazier than the rest.
say:0:1010413401:0.source_cn: 唔，这个咕布林比其他的都大。\n看上去，它疯得最严重。

say:1:1010413402:0.text: If it escapes, the general is going to have my pay reduced...
say:1:1010413402:0.source_cn: 要是放任这种怪物四处晃荡，我这个月的薪金可要泡汤了……

say:2:1010413403:0.text: You need a loan? I can offer low-interest loans, you know!
say:2:1010413403:0.source_cn: 你很缺钱吗？我可以赞助你，利息按照友情价算。

say:3:1010413404:0.text: Thanks, but no thanks. Let's take care of this one, <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
